meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声并部署到谷歌量子硬件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用谷歌量子硬件做低层电路开发或量子表征实验
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise, and deploy to Google quantum hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing low-level quantum circuits for Google hardware or running characterization experiments

howto.what: Claude 将能够使用 Cirq 框架设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持 Google 量子硬件及 IonQ、Azure Quantum 等后端，并可进行噪声建模和电路优化。
howto.when: 当您需要构建或模拟量子电路、在 Google 量子处理器上运行实验，或设计噪声感知电路时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 创建一个 Bell 态电路并模拟 1000 次。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Bell 态电路并返回直方图结果。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对参数化电路做参数扫描，theta 从 0 到 2π。
用 Cirq 在 Google 硬件上运行一个量子电路。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供处理器 ID 和项目凭据。

howto.what_en: Claude can use Cirq to design, simulate, and run quantum circuits on Google hardware or partner backends (IonQ, Azure Quantum, AQT, Pasqal), with support for noise modeling and circuit optimization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building/simulating quantum circuits, targeting Google hardware, or designing noise-aware circuits.

say_en.text: Create a Bell state circuit and simulate it 1000 times using Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the circuit and return a histogram.

say_en.text: Perform a parameter sweep over theta from 0 to 2π with Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will run the sweep and output results per theta value.

say_en.text: Run a quantum circuit on Google hardware with Cirq.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for processor ID and project credentials.
